decisions.statement: A line is said where its kind is not the kind said last.
A line whose kind is the kind said last is passed over.
A kind noted becomes the kind said last, whether or not its line was said.
A kind marked becomes the kind said last and says nothing.
A monitor handed no log says nothing and still remembers the kind.
Nothing here knows what a kind means or what a monitor watches.

definition: a monitor's line, said where the kind it reports turns rather than on every tick
